mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCnt, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN st = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successCnt, AVG(cost) AS avgCost FROM ( SELECT status AS st, cost_ms AS cost FROM rx_job_schedule_history UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(last_run_status, '')) = 'SUCCESS' THEN 'SUCCESS' ELSE 'FAILED' END AS st, NULL AS cost FROM rx_command_script WHERE last_run_time IS NOT NULL ) t
